parameter_policy: Freeze previously development-selected parameters; identical LR parameters across all three feature sets; no new search or holdout access. Exploratory reused-development comparison.
signature: exact normalized 25 non-port domain features; exclude label, row ID, ports, IP, timestamp
stress_policy: Deterministic value-based relabeling of valid positive integer ports; keep inactive zero/missing/invalid values. Within-band bijections; cross-band cyclic mapping W->R->D->W (not necessarily injective). Labels and all other raw columns unchanged. Artificial counterfactual stress, not real new capture.
latency_definition: Warm wall-clock complete in-memory raw-feature projection + imputation/encoding/scaling + predict_proba + argmax; exclude CSV IO/model loading. Shared raw rows per fold and batch; randomized configuration order each block; one thread.
scope: E4 only; no old six-ensemble rerun and no change to historical recommendation
